page.overview:
What is Tomb of the Kings?

The Tomb of the Kings is an ancient crypt located beneath Arabasta Kingdom's capital Alubarna, wherein lie the tombs and graves of the past kings of Arabasta. It is also the location of the Arabastan Poneglyph.

The Tomb of the Kings is a structure located to the west of Alubarna's royal palace. The path to the tomb is made up of bricks and lined with a grassy garden and palm trees. There is also a large gate held up by columns with ancient inscriptions on them.

Beneath the tomb exists a large underground chamber, accessed via a hidden staircase. The entry hall of the chamber contains several large columns, a sarcophagus, and two statues depicting sea cats, a sacred animal of Arabasta. It also contains stone carvings depicting the guardian deities of Arabasta, the jackal and the falcon, as well as some kind of serpentine creature.

The Arabasta Poneglyph Chamber is located deeper into the chamber, behind the last door. This is where the poneglyph that contains information on Pluton is located and has been protected by the royal family for generations, although they do not know much else about the poneglyph. Inside, there is a hidden panel that can be activated to make the room collapse.
